name: TUFNWGTP
label: ATUS final weight
notes:
This weight uses the 2006 weighting methodology and is comparable for all years. For more information see the ATUS User's Guide. Cases with [TUYEAR = 2020] will have missing values for TUFNWGTP. Researchers should use the TU20FWGT weight to construct estimates when using the 2020 data.
Files: Respondent File, Activity Summary File (the dictionary's File column).

name: TU20FWGT
label: ATUS final weight for 2020 data
notes:
When using the 2020 ATUS data, researchers need to use the weighting variable TU20FWGT instead of TUFNWGTP. The usual final weight [TUFNWGTP] on the multiyear files will have missing values for cases with [TUYEAR = 2020] on the ATUS Respondent or Activity Summary file. Cases with [TUYEAR = 2019 or 2020] will have positive values for diary dates corresponding to January 1 - March 17 or May 10 - December 31. For more information about TU20FWGT, see chapter 7 of the ATUS User's Guide.
Files: Respondent File, Activity Summary File (the dictionary's File column).

name: TRERNWA
label: Weekly earnings at main job (2 implied decimals)
notes:
This is the most-frequently used earnings variable in ATUS and is defined for all employed persons who are not self-employed or without pay. The allocation flag for this variable is TRWERNAL. Subject to topcoding (the maximum value cannot be greater than 2884.61); topcoding is indicated in TTOT, TTWK, and TTHR. Starting in June 2024, new rules were applied to TRERNWA such that the topcode values generally correspond to the top 3 percent in a given month.
Files: Respondent File, Activity Summary File (the dictionary's File column).

valid_range.note: The dictionary's Min Value and Max Value.

name: TUELDER
label: Not including financial assistance or help you provided as part of your paid job, since the first of [REF_MONTH], have you provided any care of assistance for an adult who needed help because of a condition related to aging?

questions.text: Not including financial assistance or help you provided as part of your paid job, since the first of [REF_MONTH], have you provided any care of assistance for an adult who needed help because of a condition related to aging?

notes:
The reference month is 3 months prior to the interview. For example, if the interview took place on March 15, the reference month would be December. Questions about eldercare were introduced in January 2011. Therefore, cases with [TUYEAR < 2011] will have missing values for TUELDER.
Files: Respondent File (the dictionary's File column).

name: TRTEC
label: Total time spent providing eldercare (in minutes)
notes:
TRTEC is the sum of all values of TRTEC_LN. Excludes time spent in activities with codes = 01xxxx or 0805xx. Questions about eldercare and TRTEC were introduced in January 2011. Therefore, cases with [TUYEAR < 2011] will have missing values.
Files: Respondent File (the dictionary's File column).
